subject: self.root / Frank v0.1
authority: Clay research feedback; not Frank self-harness authorization
observed_problem: Current V14 effect lifecycle can durably accept an unbound re-entry and then report COMPLETE without an explicit terminal DONE receipt.
required_runtime_semantics: Verified outcome is necessary but not sufficient for completion.
Re-entry must carry exact effect/attempt/outcome/execution/GWT causal-use/provenance identity.
REENTERED is a nonterminal cognitive/state reintegration stage.
DONE is a separate durable terminal receipt after exact support validation.
No-learning must be explicit and typed rather than represented by a missing or fabricated delta.
Recovery must distinguish OUTCOME_PENDING, REENTRY_PENDING, TERMINALIZATION_PENDING and COMPLETE.
Any stale execution generation or broken support chain fails closed and requires reconciliation, never optimistic completion.
forbidden_shortcuts: terminal credit from graph reachability or retrieval rank
causal credit from target_key label alone
learning credit from unrelated CURRENT semantic record
support authority from an unbound hash string
automatic external-effect retry after uncertain outcome
implementation_status: Candidate mechanisms exist in target repo but are not canonical/promoted.
acceptance_impact: F-V01-04 and F-V01-09 remain open until exact-current target-VPS positive, negative, crash/replay, concurrency and end-to-end receipts pass.
